thread:
Jordan (AE): Kicking off POC with NorthBank tomorrow. Need provisioning help — 2 engineers + CI service account. They want Dedicated trial (8-GPU), Okta SSO, EU data residency. Also question from their security team: hosted API keys vs ephemeral keys for guest devs. Any blockers?
Alex R: Quick q — do they need long-lived API keys for CI, or can we use short-lived/ephemeral tokens? For Dedicated we can spin up a workspace + pool and invite users with role scoping.
Jordan (AE): Prefer least-privilege: engineers only invoke models (no pool config), CI account should push artifacts and read logs but not touch billing or rollout.
Samir: We can define roles: 
- engineer: models.invoke, logs.view
- ci-service: artifacts.write, logs.view
- pool-reader: pools.view
Pool-admin remains separate. Dedicated trial can be created and we can enable ephemeral token issuance for service accounts (short TTL). Note: ephemeral hosted API tokens (delegation tokens) are simpler; Dedicated ephemeral requires the provisioning API + VPC considerations.
Marta V: For Okta SSO we use SCIM for invites + group sync so we can auto-assign the engineer role. About data residency: Hosted can pin inference to eu-west-1 but our control plane for hosted logs may still route to our main telemetry cluster unless we use a Private deployment or enterprise-dedicated control plane. Customer said: "no cross-border logs" — that pushes to Private (VPC) or an enterprise EU-only control plane addendum. I'll flag to legal.
Jordan (AE): Customer insists no control-plane telemetry leaving EU. What's the fastest path?
Marta V: Fastest: Dedicated with an enterprise EU control plane (requires contract amendment) or Private VPC on-prem. I'll draft the compliance note and a checklist of required contract terms.
Alex R: Pricing note for the PO: we can offer a 2-week zero-cost dedicated trial for evals (subject to resource limits). After that, standard reserved commit or hourly. For the 8-GPU transient pool I can give a pro-forma cost estimate today and a short promo code for the trial.
Jordan (AE): Perfect. Can we also confirm rotation for the CI key? They want automated rotation every 7 days.
Samir: Supported — service accounts can be tied to our key-rotation flow, or they integrate with KMS/HSM and we issue short-lived tokens via our IAM broker. Recommended: KMS + rotation with 7-day TTL tokens.
Alex R: I'll prepare: 1) short quote with trial promo, 2) instructions for SCIM group mapping, 3) sample RBAC mapping and ephemeral-token snippet.
Jordan (AE): Action items: Alex — quote + temp pool; Samir — create role templates + ephemeral key flow; Marta — confirm SSO/SCIM and EU-control-plane legal note. Target: 3 business days.
Presales Bot: Created task: presales#1715001234 — owners: Alex R (quote), Samir (roles/keys), Marta V (compliance). Due in 3 business days. :white_check_mark:
Jordan (AE): Looping in @Marta V and @Alex R on the thread. I'll update NorthBank with the tentative timeline and ask for Okta admin contact. Thanks everyone. :pray:
